messages:
luke_sales: PioneerGrid POC blocked by CISO: they will not sign without BYOK (customer-managed KMS) + explicit EU-only egress guarantee. Procurement also wants firm dates. Need exec bridge today.
anya_se: Quick tech note: workload ~200 qps, short sequences. They want Private with BYOK + HSM attestation. We can demo on Hosted EU, but prod requires BYOK. Legal asked for an attestation doc + timeline.
ramon_eng_infra: We can support BYOK (AWS/GCP/Azure) and do key wrap; HSM attestation generation requires security review + audit munging — realistic ETA is 7 business days. Can offer provisional attestation in ~3 business days if we escalate infra and security.
tia_sales_ops: Procurement asking what concession we need to offer to accept a 7-day formal window. Also want to know if a provisional attestation + SOC2 addendum is acceptable.
marta_vp_sales: I can run the bridge at 16:00 UTC. Proposed plan: 1) offer Hosted EU demo path immediately, 2) commit to provisional attestation within 3 days (formal in 7), 3) propose commercial concession to close. Ramon, can infra commit to 3-day provisional?
ramon_eng_infra: Marking INFRA-8672 for priority. Provisioning Dedicated pool for 200 qps p99 <120ms needs 3x A40-equivalent nodes for redundancy; provisioning ETA 3 business days in EU. Provisional attestation artifacts (template + sample logs) can be produced in 3 business days if security signs off on expedited review.
sarah_custsuccess: I'll schedule the bridge and coordinate the customer. Suggested attendees: PioneerGrid CISO (marcus.c), CTO (jess), procurement (anna.p).
ops-bot: Created ticket INFRA-8672: "PioneerGrid BYOK attestation + EU dedicated pool" assigned to ramon_eng_infra. Fields: priority=high, provisional_attest_eta=3d, formal_attest_eta=7d, dedicated_pool_eta=3d. Reminders set at 48h/72h.
luke_sales: Marta leading bridge. Tia please prepare a shaped concession. Anya prepare a one-pager technical statement (BYOK flow, egress controls, perf benchmarks). Ramon update INFRA-8672 when infra starts.
tia_sales_ops: Draft concession: Option A — 30% off first 90 days on committed Dedicated; Option B — Hosted EU trial free for 3 months with no-penalty exit if BYOK not delivered in 7 days. Sending draft to Marta in 20m.
anya_se: One-pager outline I'm preparing includes this BYOK flow snippet to show the CISO:
```
Redwood BYOK flow:
1) Customer creates CMK in their KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault)
2) Customer provides key policy and allowlist for Redwood service principals
3) Redwood binds key via key-wrap; no plaintext key stored in runtime
4) Audit logs & access proofs provided; provisional attestation artifact available
```
ramon_eng_infra: I'll attach sample attestation used for other enterprise customers to INFRA-8672 so legal can review wording. If they need HSM certs we will require 7 business days for formal certs.
marta_vp_sales: OK. Bridge at 16:00 UTC. Goal: get PioneerGrid to accept Hosted EU demo + provisional attestation to unblock procurement, and sign a short-term commercial concession while we deliver formal BYOK.
luke_sales: Meeting link posted. Please update INFRA-8672 with any new info. :thumbsup:
